§§§§ query, minified
query Orders($city:String!,$first:Int=10,$after:ID,$tags:[String!]!=["a","b"],$filter:OrderFilter={status:PAID,min:1.5}){orders(city:$city,first:$first,after:$after){edges{node{id total customer{name}}}pageInfo{hasNextPage endCursor}}}
§§§§ anonymous query and commas
{a,b,c d e:f(x:1,y:2,),g{h,i}}
§§§§ aliases, arguments and values
query Q { small: image(size: 64) big: image(size: 1024, format: PNG, crop: {x: 0, y: -1, w: 1.5e2, h: 0.5}) list(ids: [1, 2, 3], names: ["a", "b"], flags: [true, false, null], nested: [[1], [2, [3]]], empty: [], obj: {}) text(s: "quote \" and \\ and é and \n", e: "") enumValue(e: RED) variable(v: $v) }
§§§§ block strings
{
  field(text: """
    Hello,
      indented World!

    Yours,
      GraphQL.
  """, one: """one line""", quote: """has \""" inside""", empty: """""")
}
§§§§ fragments and directives
query Hero($episode: Episode, $withFriends: Boolean!, $skip: Boolean = false) @cached(ttl: 60) {
  hero(episode: $episode) @include(if: $withFriends) @skip(if: $skip) { ...HeroFields ... on Droid { primaryFunction } ... on Human @defer(label: "h") { height(unit: METER) } ... @include(if: true) { id } ... { name } }
}
fragment HeroFields on Character @live { name friends(first: 2) @connection(key: "Hero_friends", filter: ["a"]) { edges { node { ...HeroFields } } } }
§§§§ mutation and subscription
mutation AddOrder($input:AddOrderInput!){addOrder(input:$input){order{id status}errors{field message}}}
subscription OnOrder($id:ID!){orderChanged(id:$id){id status updatedAt}}
mutation{like(id:1){count}}
§§§§ several operations with comments
# leading comment
query A { a } # trailing comment

# between operations
query B {
  # inside a selection
  b # after a field
  c(
    # inside arguments
    x: 1 # after an argument
  )
}
# last comment
§§§§ schema: types, interfaces, unions
schema{query:Query mutation:Mutation subscription:Subscription}
"""A customer order"""
type Order implements Node&Timestamped@key(fields:"id"){"The id" id:ID! total(currency:Currency=INR,round:Boolean=true):Float! items(first:Int=10,after:String):[Item!]! customer:Customer @deprecated(reason:"use buyer") tags:[[String]]}
interface Node{id:ID!}
interface Timestamped implements Node{id:ID! createdAt:DateTime!}
union SearchResult=|Order|Customer|Item
union Short=A|B
scalar DateTime@specifiedBy(url:"https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3339")
enum Currency{INR USD @deprecated EUR}
input OrderFilter{status:Status=PAID min:Float max:Float tags:[String!]=[] nested:Inner={a:1}}
directive@key(fields:String!)repeatable on OBJECT|INTERFACE
directive @cached(ttl:Int=60,scope:Scope=PUBLIC) on QUERY|FIELD
§§§§ schema: extensions and descriptions
"""
A long description

  with an indented line
and "quotes" inside.
"""
type Query {
  "single line description"
  order(
    "the id"
    id: ID!
  ): Order
  """block on a field"""
  orders(city: String, first: Int = 10): [Order!]!
}
extend type Query { me: Customer }
extend schema @link(url: "https://specs.apollo.dev/federation/v2.0") { subscription: Subscription }
extend union SearchResult = Shop
extend enum Currency { GBP }
extend input OrderFilter { city: String }
extend interface Node @tag(name: "x")
extend scalar DateTime @tag(name: "y")
type Empty
§§§§ long lines that must break
query VeryLongOperationName($firstVariable: String!, $secondVariable: Int = 100, $thirdVariable: [ID!]!, $fourthVariable: SomeInputType) { someFieldWithManyArguments(firstArgument: $firstVariable, secondArgument: $secondVariable, thirdArgument: $thirdVariable, fourthArgument: $fourthVariable) { id } }
type T { fieldWithManyArguments(firstArgument: String!, secondArgument: Int = 100, thirdArgument: [ID!]!, fourthArgument: SomeInputType): String }
